_doc: rc9.0-b RMISS VO manifest: AD rc90_mission_vo (27 rows) + rc90b_batch1_vo (25 rows) merged, 52 rows. Files at audio/vo_ai/{ogg,m4a}/rm_*.{ogg,m4a} (RMVO uses the ogg basename + BASE audio/vo_ai/). Radio rows have FX baked: RMVO plays every rm_* clip with SamplePlayer.play(), never radioLine(). AD dry (no-FX) takes are NOT shipped. Aliases (no copy shipped, the target clip plays): rm_o2_ack_1/rm_o3_ack_1/rm_o4_ack_1 -> rm_o1_ack_1, rm_brch_win_1 -> rm_m1_win_1. rm_o1_follow_1 -> vo_ai LT-G04 when vo_ai is loaded, else the pack's rm_o1_follow_1 copy.
